name: Vivere
source:
Vivere's quiet nature obscures his vicious tendencies. He is the monster hidden within Pario's walls. It is by his mercy that you aren't dead yet.

[From [url=https://stygianeyedev.itch.io/sacrarium-pario]Itch.io[/url]]
